description: Desired MCP inventory for a NemoClaw development sandbox. This is documentation, not a credential-bearing NemoClaw state file.

servers.name: unity-mcp
servers.purpose: Inspect and configure the local HackGTUnity editor and scenes.
servers.registration: nemoclaw <sandbox> mcp add unity-mcp --url <endpoint> --env UNITY_MCP_BRIDGE_TOKEN --trusted-private-host <WINDOWS_WSL_GATEWAY_IP> --deny-tool Unity_AssetGeneration_GenerateAsset (done by scripts/unity-mcp-bridge/nemoclaw-register.sh; the token is a random placeholder because the bridge has no auth)
servers.notes: Served by scripts/unity-mcp-bridge (a TLS proxy in front of mcp-proxy, which wraps Unity's relay_win.exe --mcp), bound to the Windows side of the WSL switch only. The sandbox must be onboarded with this machine's private CA (NEMOCLAW_CORPORATE_CA_BUNDLE); a plain rebuild drops it. Never expose the endpoint publicly. The Unity_RunCommand approval gate is a target, not yet enforced.
